images.title: All your looks in one gallery
images.description: Save your skin, model, cape, and outer-layer settings together in complete looks and switch between them with one click.
images.alt: The My looks gallery with several saved looks, the active look, and buttons to edit, duplicate, and delete looks.

images.title: Check skin compatibility at a glance
images.description: Badges show support for Ears, Fresh Moves, and Just Expressions and warn about conflicts with active mods and resource packs.
images.alt: The look editor with an Ears skin and an open tooltip warning about a facial animation conflict.

images.title: Build your look with a live preview
images.description: Choose a Classic or Slim model using visual cards and customize your appearance across separate tabs, right in the game.
images.alt: The look editor with a large player preview, vertical tabs, and Classic and Slim model cards.

images.title: Explore skin collections
images.description: Browse skin collections from resource packs, search for skins, and filter them by model type.
images.alt: The skin catalog with a resource pack collection, a search field, and a model type filter.

images.title: Import skins and models your way
images.description: Add skins from files, links, or player names, and bring over looks from launchers and mods. With CPM installed, you can import model files too.
images.alt: The Import tab with player search, a link field listing png, cpmmodel, and cpmproject formats, and buttons to import from a file, a launcher, or another mod.

images.title: Review looks before importing
images.description: Compare new looks and duplicates, check skin compatibility, and select only the ones you want.
images.alt: The Review import screen with groups of new and duplicate looks, a selected card, and compatibility badges.

images.title: Open your looks from Minecraft menus
images.description: Click your character on the title screen or pause menu to open My looks.
images.alt: The Minecraft pause menu with a preview of the current player to the right of the buttons.

images.title: Your own capes, HD textures, and animated collections
images.description: Import static and animated capes, including HD textures, and save them in your looks. Resource pack collections support the same formats. These capes are visible only to you.
images.alt: The editor's cape tab with personal capes, a resource pack collection, search, an elytra filter, and a large preview of the selected HD cape.

images.title: Find a cape with an elytra texture
images.description: Search capes by name, filter for elytra textures, and preview the result immediately.
images.alt: The cape catalog with the With elytra filter and a preview of the selected elytra.

images.title: Appearance providers and outer layers
images.description: Configure skin and cape sources separately. When your provider settings make the gallery unavailable, adjust a regular skin's outer layers directly on the Providers screen.
images.alt: The skin tab on the Providers screen with Offline and Minecraft rows, a regular player preview, and three outer-layer buttons for the head, body, and legs.

images.title: Change your appearance offline too
images.description: Create and apply looks locally. Syncing with your Minecraft profile can wait until your game session is available again.
images.alt: The skin providers tab with different skins for Offline and Minecraft and the local skin in the player preview.

images.title: Capes from different sources
images.description: Combine OptiFine, SkinMC, MinecraftCapes, Sneaky Capes, and CPM accessories with official and local capes. Set their priorities and check provider capabilities using the badges.
images.alt: The cape tab on the Providers screen with Offline, Minecraft, OptiFine, SkinMC, MinecraftCapes, Sneaky Capes, and CPM rows, capability badges, and a MinecraftCapes cape preview.

images.title: CPM models in your saved looks
images.description: Use Customizable Player Models and inspect the model's built-in capes and elytra directly in the editor after joining a world. Inspection does not change the look's saved assignments.
images.alt: The look editor with a custom CPM model in the large preview and the expanded Embedded collection showing the model's available accessories.

images.title: Import a model without manual export
images.description: Open a cpmmodel or cpmproject file from your device or a link. If the model needs a base skin, choose one during import and continue creating your look.
images.alt: Base skin selection for an imported CPM model, with a selection heading, a catalog of available skins, and a model type filter.
